narr: Slow moving thunderstorms along a frontal boundary resulted in a localized two to four inches of rain. This resulted in instances of flash flooding.
ev: Reports of several roads closed in Dundalk due to high water. This includes North Point Boulevard near I-695, German Hill Road, Broening Highway, and Merrit Boulevard.
Joppa Farm Road closed near Philadelphia Road due to at least six inches of water flowing over the roadway.
